resources.string: Play the downloaded Godot game independently. Dependencies are requested on first use; existing Web saves are kept separately.

The minigame requires a one-time download of the Godot engine and the latest game from GitHub (about 102 MiB). It needs Android 9+ and arm64, and additional storage for offline resources. The minigame will only be selected after installation succeeds. Existing Web saves will be kept, not automatically converted.

Download and verify this GitHub release, then activate it for the next launch. After success, old game files are removed and only the current engine is kept. Installation failures keep the previous version and all saves. Close the minigame before updating; the engine is downloaded only if required.
The minigame is running or updating. Close it and try again.
The Godot minigame requires Android 9+ and an arm64 device
Verifying engine, game and offline resources…

Press Back again within 2 seconds to save and return to the launcher

The minigame engine could not continue. Return to the launcher? Existing saves will be kept; the latest progress may not have been saved.
Saving has not been confirmed. You can keep waiting (or retry in the minigame), or discard this session’s unsaved progress and return. Existing saves will not be deleted.
